name: Mobility_Retail_Recreation
formula: mean_d(retail_and_recreation_percent_change_from_baseline_d) for d in quarter t; 0.0 outside the reporting window

name: Mobility_Grocery_Pharmacy
formula: mean_d(grocery_and_pharmacy_percent_change_from_baseline_d) for d in quarter t; 0.0 outside the reporting window

name: Mobility_Parks
formula: mean_d(parks_percent_change_from_baseline_d) for d in quarter t; 0.0 outside the reporting window

name: Mobility_Transit_Stations
formula: mean_d(transit_stations_percent_change_from_baseline_d) for d in quarter t; 0.0 outside the reporting window

name: Mobility_Workplaces
formula: mean_d(workplaces_percent_change_from_baseline_d) for d in quarter t; 0.0 outside the reporting window

name: Mobility_Residential
formula: mean_d(residential_percent_change_from_baseline_d) for d in quarter t; 0.0 outside the reporting window

name: CO2e_dlog
formula: log(CO2e_{t-1}) - log(CO2e_{t-2})  [shifted by 1 to exclude CO2e_t]

name: Grid_CI_mean
formula: mean(CI_t for t in quarter q)

name: Grid_CI_p90
formula: P90(CI_t for t in quarter q)

name: Grid_CI_std
formula: std(CI_t for t in quarter q)

name: OWID_RenewableShare_L1Y
formula: OWID renewable-electricity-share_{y-1} for every quarter in year y

name: OWID_LowCarbonShare_L1Y
formula: OWID low-carbon-electricity-share_{y-1} for every quarter in year y
